summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I already checked (read-only, no edits made):** I traced the full path — `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables — and it looks correctly wired, which is worth flagging up front:  - The watchlist router requires a valid session on every route and injects `X-User-Id` from the server-verified session (not from anything the client sends). - Every handler (list, get, create, rename, delete, add item, remove item) filters or check
